title: The Quiet Witness
author: Rosalind Tamayo
tagline: She is sworn to add nothing. Then she hears the lie.
description: Federal court interpreter Marisol Quintanilla is sworn to say exactly what others say and nothing more. In a Newark racketeering trial, a thin wall lets her hear a lawyer teach the star witness to change one Spanish word. Speaking could end her career. Silence could cost a man his life.
authorBio: Rosalind Tamayo grew up in northern New Jersey and worked for many years as a court interpreter. She lives near Newark, where she writes novels about language, loyalty and the law.
contentNotes: Contains a workplace death, witness intimidation and themes of immigration and family estrangement.
